propositions: Enable both verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close in rebar.toml while retaining false defaults in the reusable configuration schema.

Verify that legacy unpinned attestations, unchanged successful re-reviews, and stale material-pin drift are handled correctly through end-to-end lifecycle tests without eager backfill or graph-wide invalidation.
Prove that depends_on and blocks references normalize to one canonical prerequisite pin/evaluation, and that execution-time self-edits and return-to-open resets are handled correctly.
Verify no schema migration, new pin command, or ordinary list-output changes are introduced, and document the policy cutover in CHANGELOG.md and docs/release-notes.md.
Public CLI validation must reject stale-pin-drift with exit 1 and missing close-plan review with exit 1, leaving status unchanged and providing remediation text.
Confirm deleted/archived target handling, concurrency rechecks, and enable/disable/re-enable cycles work correctly through public lifecycle surfaces.
